title: Encyclopaedia Britannica; or, A dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature - Fourth edition, Volume 14 Part 1, MIC-Moral philosophy - EB.9
text:
The fore analyzed above by Berganain, was from
Puy in Velay, in France, and is confirmed by Dalo-
meea as volcanic. The other by Kliprath, is from
Bohemia. Excepting the final proportion of manga-
arde detected in the latter, the coincidence of the two
analysis is very striking.
